name: issue_1243_cancel_ends_a_lone_automation_grace
description: Issue #1243: the dashboard's Cancel Override button pressed while only Climate Advisor's own automation grace is running (no occupant override behind it) ends that grace, as production's cancel_override() does since #1095.
notes: Occupant impact: after a door closes, Climate Advisor resumes cooling and starts its own 90-minute automation grace; the dashboard shows that grace. The occupant presses Cancel Override to end it. The button must end the grace (the dashboard answers 'grace cancelled'); if it silently did nothing, the dashboard would keep showing a grace the occupant just cancelled.

Harness: the cancel_override event now makes the same two calls as api.py's ClimateAdvisorCancelOverrideView.post() -- decide_sync(ae.cancel_override, reason='user_cancel_override'), then _schedule_reclassify_after_cancel() when something was cancelled. The pre-#1243 event only acted when _manual_override_active was set, so on this scenario it did nothing and both assertions below failed (grace still active, no grace_cancelled row).

(a) Scenario effectiveness: delete the `or self._grace_active` term from cancel_override()'s nothing-to-cancel guard (automation.py, the `if not (self._occupant_override_active() or self._grace_active or self._fan_off_hold_active())` line) and cancel_override() returns False here: no grace_cancelled row and _grace_active stays true, so both assertions fail.

(b) Two-way alignment: docs/grace-periods-spec.md (Cancel Override ends a lone grace, #1095) and docs/sim-harness-spec.md (event dispatch table: cancel_override) describe what this scenario exercises.

(c) User outcome if a regression slipped through: the occupant's Cancel Override would no longer end a grace with no override behind it, and the dashboard would keep counting down a grace they cancelled.
Pending, not golden: goldens are locked until the owner approves a scenario card. Enforced by tests/test_production_harness.py::test_issue_1243_cancel_pending_scenario_passes_production_engine.

events.note: Outdoor hotter than indoor: nat-vent not viable, so an open door pauses the AC.
Door opens: Climate Advisor pauses the AC.
Door closes: Climate Advisor resumes cooling and starts its own 90-minute automation grace. No occupant override exists.
The occupant presses Cancel Override on the dashboard while only the automation grace runs.
Same readings; moves the clock past the cancel's 10 s follow-up re-apply.

assertions.reason: Precondition: the door close resumed cooling (this starts the automation grace).
The Cancel Override press ended Climate Advisor's own grace, recorded with the button's reason.
Final state: no grace is running (without the cancel the 90-minute grace would still run until 16:15).

verdict.summary: Cancel Override ends a lone automation grace
verdict.observed_behavior: grace_cancelled (reason user_cancel_override, grace_source automation) at 14:50; no grace at the end
verdict.expected_behavior: The dashboard's Cancel Override ends any grace that is running, even with no occupant override behind it (#1095)
